question.zh: 恒生指数在 2026-12-02 或之后首个交易日收盘，会高于 2026-11-02 吗？
question.en: Will Hang Seng close higher on the first trading day on or after 2026-12-02 than on 2026-11-02?

rationale.zh: 近 20 个交易日波动 1.03%/日，平均涨跌 -0.08%/日（按一半计入），周期约 21 个交易日（一个月）。
rationale.en: 20-day volatility 1.03%/day; average move -0.08%/day, counted at half weight; about 21 trading days (one month).
